population: All 20 configured competitions, evaluated independently; all scored fixtures in the previous historical evaluation/recent and early windows are retained. High-priced/strong-favourite subsets cannot replace the full denominator.
training: Within competition only. Prior-day team goals/strength, stage and venue, separate home and away goal-difference ratings coupled with the alternate venue. Markets require actual prices, and early and main datasets are separate chronological refits. Same-day games cannot update each other's inputs.
score_model: Factor the distribution into total goals and allocation of that total to the home team. Use continuation-ratio binary logits through 8 goals and preserve the anchor's relative probabilities above 8. Fit a ridge-logistic residual and a shallow gradient-boosted residual with the same market/team prior offsets. At inference enumerate the possible totals without observing the target total. Output three unique scores from one distribution.
selection: Fold one trains model parameters. Choose between the unchanged anchor, linear residual and shallow tree residual at mixing weights 0,.25,.5,.75,1 solely by mean exact-score log-loss on the chronological second fold. Report unchanged anchor and fixed half-weight arms as ablations. Freeze the selected recipe before test scores; direction, full-win totals and first three scores each follow the chosen joint distribution.
comparisons: R6 agreement on identical actual fixture IDs/lines; pure observed market where defined; source-clock reconstruction on Phoenix T-24h and T-1h; first-score/ordered-three, WDL and strict whole-win Asian totals with all five settlements and coverage. Date-cluster paired bootstrap, fixed seed, 1000 iterations. Report probabilistic loss separately.
additional_history: Six domestic European competitions (England, Spain, Germany, Italy, France, Netherlands), 2010/11 and 2011/12 training, 2012/13 validation, 2013/14 final test. Compare the time-refitted R6 agreement rule and both fixed arms where inputs are available. This is an additional historical test, not a prospective claim.
phoenix: English and Spanish top flights. Fixed training before 2022-07-01, calibration 2022/23, evaluation 2023/24 onward as available. Compare quoted market WDL only where actual odds exist, and same IDs across quote times. Derived historical display clock. Leave totals absent when prices are absent.
passing_graph: Wyscout 2017/18 five European leagues. Predeclare first dates before 2017-12-01 for fitting, December-January for calibration, then February 2018 on for assessment. Compare identical simple pre-match Poisson residuals with and without prior-match passing-network features; current match events barred. Separate fixture identity and subset; this ablation is not a HIGFormer replication.
decision_and_forward: New candidates and all control forecasts recorded independently; include the already registered prospective slate's remaining unstarted matches at actual freeze time. Active Current/Test are not promoted by historical replay.
